description: Changes how Gene learns. for "everyone" (owners and admins only) sets any setting for the whole workspace; for "me" lets anyone make Gene stricter for themselves: a source's choice (never looser than everyone's) or pausing learning for themselves. A choice for yourself equal to everyone's goes back to following everyone. Only what you send changes; the answer is every setting as it now reads.

check_schedule_days.description: How often to check prices and opening hours: every 91, 182 or 365 days, or null for never. For everyone only.

for.description: Whom the change is for: the whole workspace, or the person alone.

forget_short_lived.description: Whether short-lived things are forgotten when they pass. For everyone only.

morning_summary.description: Whether owners and admins get the morning summary of what Gene learned. For everyone only.

paused.description: true pauses learning (Gene still uses what it knows), false resumes.

sources.description: Each source to change, to its choice.

unused_after_days.description: After how many days unused Gene asks about an entry (182 or 365), or null for never. For everyone only.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: set_learning_settings
title: Change how Gene learns
